passages.provision_quote: A local government shall not enact or enforce any charter provision, ordinance, or regulation requiring a person to present identification for the purpose of voting or submitting a ballot at any polling place, vote center, or other location where ballots are cast or submitted, unless required by state or federal law.
passages.note: Preemption bill decides which level sets ID rules, not what the rule is (H12).
Berman voted Aye on this Assembly floor vote for SB 1174, a preemption bill (H12).

rows.reasoning: SB 1174 prohibits local governments from requiring identification to vote, which decides which level of government may set an ID rule rather than what identification the state itself should require; per H12 this is adjacent, not on-question, so no passage survives V1-V5 to establish a chair.
needs_source: Berman's own record or statement setting the state's voter ID requirement (photo ID, non-photo ID, or no ID), independent of the SB 1174 local-preemption clause
